metadata.question: Did the water extent in Lake Killamperpunna increase between June 20, 2025 and September 15, 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Target: Lake Killamperpunna, South Australia. Use a fixed ROI around expected location (near Innamincka). Additionally constrain analysis area using JRC Global Surface Water max extent within ROI.
- Collections: Primary: COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED. Fallback: LANDSAT 8/9 Collection 2 Level 2.
- Dates: Centered on 2025-06-20 and 2025-09-15. Try ±10 days, then widen to ±20, ±30, ±45. If still empty, attempt Landsat with ±30.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds and shadows.
  - S2: Use SCL to keep classes [4,5,6,7,11]; remove 0,1,3,8,9,10.
  - Landsat: Use QA_PIXEL bits (cloud/shadow).
- Compute MNDWI = (Green - SWIR1)/(Green + SWIR1). Water = MNDWI > 0.
- Limit to plausible lake area using JRC GSW max_extent within ROI; if empty, fall back to ROI.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If both periods have images but valid pixel count after masking is 0 -> C2.
- If any computed area is null/NaN -> C3.
- If no images for a period after expanding and Landsat fallback -> C1.
- Otherwise compare areas (allow small tolerance).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      try {
        obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(res);
        });
      } catch (e) {
        reject(e);
      }
    });
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  // Approximate location near Innamincka, SA; buffer to cover Lake Killamperpunna and surroundings.
  const lakeCenter = ee.Geometry.Point([140.55, -27.95]);
  const roi = lakeCenter.buffer(15000); // 15 km buffer

  const center1 = ee.Date('2025-06-20');
  const center2 = ee.Date('2025-09-15');
  const windowCandidates = [10, 20, 30, 45]; // days half-window

  // Constrain analysis area using Global Surface Water max extent
  const gsw = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater');
  let maxExtent = gsw.select('max_extent').clip(roi).gt(0);
  // Count pixels in maxExtent at coarse scale to ensure non-zero
  const extentCount = await getInfoAsync(
    maxExtent.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('max_extent')
  );
  let analysisArea = roi;
  if (!extentCount || extentCount === 0) {
    console.log('GSW max_extent pixels: 0 -> using ROI as analysis area');
  } else {
    analysisArea = maxExtent.selfMask().geometry(1);
    // Still use mask to restrict pixels
  }

  // 2. Data Acquisition & Processing Functions
  function maskS2(img) {
    const scl = img.select('SCL');
    const keep = scl.eq(4).or(scl.eq(5)).or(scl.eq(6)).or(scl.eq(7)).or(scl.eq(11));
    return img.updateMask(keep);
  }
  function addMNDWI_S2(img) {
    const green = img.select('B3').toFloat();
    const swir1 = img.select('B11').toFloat();
    const mndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('MNDWI');
    return img.addBands(mndwi);
  }
  function getS2Collection(start, end) {
    return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(roi)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80))
      .map(maskS2)
      .map(addMNDWI_S2);
  }

  // Landsat fallback
  function maskLandsatL2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
    const shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0);
    const mask = cloud.or(shadow).not();
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }
  function scaleLandsatL2(img) {
    const srBands = ['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B5','SR_B6'];
    const scaled = img.select(srBands).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return img.addBands(scaled, null, true);
  }
  function addMNDWI_LS(img) {
    const green = img.select('SR_B3');
    const swir1 = img.select('SR_B6');
    const mndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('MNDWI');
    return img.addBands(mndwi);
  }
  function getLandsatCollection(start, end) {
    const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2');
    const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2');
    const col = l8.merge(l9)
      .filterBounds(roi)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .map(scaleLandsatL2)
      .map(maskLandsatL2)
      .map(addMNDWI_LS);
    return col;
  }

  async function getBestComposite(centerDate, label) {
    for (let i = 0; i < windowCandidates.length; i++) {
      const halfDays = windowCandidates[i];
      const start = ee.Date(centerDate).advance(-halfDays, 'day');
      const end = ee.Date(centerDate).advance(halfDays, 'day');
      let s2 = getS2Collection(start, end);
      const s2Count = await getInfoAsync(s2.size());
      if (s2Count > 0) {
        const comp = s2.median().set('images', s2Count).set('start', start).set('end', end).set('sensor', 'S2');
        return comp;
      }
      // try Landsat only when window is moderately wide (>=30 days)
      if (halfDays >= 30) {
        let ls = getLandsatCollection(start, end);
        const lsCount = await getInfoAsync(ls.size());
        if (lsCount > 0) {
          const comp = ls.median().set('images', lsCount).set('start', start).set('end', end).set('sensor', 'LS');
          return comp;
        }
      }
    }
    // No images found
    console.log(label + ' Images: 0');
    return null;
  }

  function computeStats(comp, label) {
    // Build analysis mask: if GSW extent available, use it, else use ROI
    let maskGeom = analysisArea;
    let mndwi = comp.select('MNDWI').updateMask(ee.Image.constant(1));
    // Valid pixels within analysis area
    const validCount = mndwi.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: maskGeom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('MNDWI');
    // Total analysis pixels (coarse)
    const totalCount = ee.Image.constant(1).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: maskGeom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('constant');

    // Water area (km^2) using threshold MNDWI > 0
    const water = mndwi.gt(0).selfMask();
    const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6).updateMask(water);
    const waterArea = areaImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: maskGeom,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('area');

    return {
      validCount,
      totalCount,
      waterArea
    };
  }

  // 3. Run composites for both periods
  const comp1 = await getBestComposite(center1, 'Jun');
  const comp2 = await getBestComposite(center2, 'Sep');
  if (!comp1 || !comp2) {
    console.log('One or both periods have no images after attempts.');
    console.log('C1');
    return;
  }

  // 4. Calculation and validation
  const imgs1 = await getInfoAsync(comp1.get('images'));
  const imgs2 = await getInfoAsync(comp2.get('images'));
  const start1 = await getInfoAsync(ee.Date(comp1.get('start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
  const end1 = await getInfoAsync(ee.Date(comp1.get('end')).format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
  const start2 = await getInfoAsync(ee.Date(comp2.get('start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
  const end2 = await getInfoAsync(ee.Date(comp2.get('end')).format('YYYY-MM-dd'));
  const sens1 = await getInfoAsync(comp1.get('sensor'));
  const sens2 = await getInfoAsync(comp2.get('sensor'));

  const stats1 = computeStats(comp1, 'Jun');
  const stats2 = computeStats(comp2, 'Sep');

  const v1 = await getInfoAsync(stats1.validCount);
  const t1 = await getInfoAsync(stats1.totalCount);
  const v2 = await getInfoAsync(stats2.validCount);
  const t2 = await getInfoAsync(stats2.totalCount);
  const a1 = await getInfoAsync(stats1.waterArea);
  const a2 = await getInfoAsync(stats2.waterArea);

  console.log(`Jun window ${start1} to ${end1} | ${sens1} images: ${imgs1}`);
  console.log(`Sep window ${start2} to ${end2} | ${sens2} images: ${imgs2}`);

  if ((t1 === null || t1 === 0) || (t2 === null || t2 === 0)) {
    console.log('No analysis pixels in area (mask empty).');
    console.log('C2');
    return;
  }
  console.log(`Analysis pixels (1km): Jun valid ${v1}/${t1} (${(v1/t1*100).toFixed(1)}%), Sep valid ${v2}/${t2} (${(v2/t2*100).toFixed(1)}%)`);

  if (v1 === 0 || v2 === 0) {
    console.log('No valid pixels after masking for one or both periods.');
    console.log('C2');
    return;
  }
  if (a1 === null || a2 === null || isNaN(a1) || isNaN(a2)) {
    console.log('Area calculation returned null/NaN.');
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }

  console.log(`Water area (km^2): Jun ${a1.toFixed(3)}, Sep ${a2.toFixed(3)}`);
  const delta = a2 - a1;
  console.log(`Change (Sep - Jun) km^2: ${delta.toFixed(3)}`);

  // 5. Final Answer
  const tol = 0.05; // km^2 tolerance to avoid noise
  if (delta > tol) {
    console.log('A');
  } else {
    console.log('B');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
